verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), so agents can use Elasticsearch indexes as a tool through a first-party MCP surface. The evidence confirms only that the server exists, not which operations it exposes. The marketing line about building 'AI apps and agents' adds only general support. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific tools exposed (query, analytics/aggregations, index management), any read/write or permission scoping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
